This article explores the core principles for building and operating reliable AI agents, highlighting the critical role of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how platforms like Metorialprovide the serverless infrastructure needed to bridge the gap from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.

items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that’s revolutionizing how AI agents connect to external tools and data. While building a basic MCP server is straightforward, deploying, scaling, and securing it for production is a significant challenge.
